response.justification: Bogdan has extensive experience in software engineering, including building high-performance microservices and founding a geospatial data platform (GISCollective). While his recent roles focus on TypeScript and Node.js, his background in systems programming with DLang and older C++ experience, combined with his deep knowledge of GIS data processing, make him a strong candidate for this routing tiling role.
strengths: Strong domain expertise in geospatial data processing and GIS platforms, demonstrated as the founder of GISCollective.
Proven ability to build high-performance, low-latency distributed systems handling millions of requests per second.
Solid foundation in systems programming and open-source development, with prior C/C++ and extensive DLang experience.
concerns: Lacks recent professional experience with modern C++ or Rust, which are the primary languages required for this role.
Recent professional roles are heavily focused on full-stack web development (TypeScript, Node.js) rather than backend data pipelines.
No explicit mention of specific routing algorithms or navigation guidance solutions, despite general GIS experience.
